messages:
lauren_product: Need to finalise pilot scope for enterprise audit/BYOK. Customers want exportable evidence, tenant-level separation, SOC2 mapping, retention + legal hold. Thoughts?

 tom_pm: Pilot = per-tenant immutable store, async export bundle (NDJSON + manifest + detached signature), BYOK opt-in (wrap-on-write), basic retention tiers (30d/1yr). No escrow for pilot.

 anika_legal: Manifest must include key ids, signer, timestamps, and chain-of-custody summary. Need legal-hold override flow and audit trail for holds/releases. Add SOC2 control mapping in customer acceptance doc.

 mike_sre: Ops constraints: small exports (<=30d) SLA 2h, bulk exports <=24h. Alerting: >30m warning, >2h pager. Throttle concurrent exports per-tenant (pilot=3). Retention must survive region failovers.

 jordan_eng: Implementation idea: tenant-specific Kafka topics -> immutable blob objects with versioned keys -> manifest builder emits newline-delimited manifest plus manifest.sig (ed25519). BYOK: accept customer KMS wrap key, store key metadata only.

 lauren_product: Pilot acceptance checklist: 3 tenants onboarded, export success rate >=97% for 7d, manifests validate, BYOK handshake + rotation preserved, runbook exercised.

 tom_pm: Risks: multi-year retention cost; recommend committed billing for >2yr. BYOK increases onboarding time (~2-4 business days).

 anika_legal: Keep escrow opt-in and contract-gated; include PII redaction presets in pilot as a toggle.

 lauren_product: Action items: @jordan_eng write pilot design + sample curl; @mike_sre draft runbook + alerts; @anika_legal draft acceptance + privacy checklist. I'll schedule kickoff with pilots.

 ops_bot: infra-bot: Pilot namespace created: pilot-audit-03. Blobs -> s3://pilot-audit-2026.
